title: Governance cost metrics and execution accounting
rawUserRequest: Implement the approved 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan in performance-first order. Execute in English low-token mode; keep Work Items separate and convergent. This WI must make governance execution cost measurable without changing policy decisions.

declaredIntent.summary: Expose repository-local governance execution cost and preserve unknowns before optimization and parallel execution WIs.

outOfScope: Changing governance decisions based on metrics

sources.reason: Existing structured lifecycle and gate event source.
WI-01 evidence-only timing and bottleneck semantics.
Existing local timing and unknown-wait tests.
Existing boundary between local measurements and governance decisions.

riskAssessment.reason: Metrics must remain evidence-only, deterministic, and fail closed when values are unavailable.

reasons: Local reporting and schema changes; no policy decision or network access.

executionDecision.reason: Contract is concrete and the implementation is bounded to local evidence reporting.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A versioned governance-cost report records observed local compute, gate/verification runs, retries, backtracks, and human decisions for one Work Item.
Provider wait, human wait, token usage, and unavailable recovery time remain explicit unknown values; no estimates are emitted.
Cross-Work-Item or malformed event evidence is excluded or rejected fail-closed, and report digests are deterministic for identical evidence.
The report is advisory-only and cannot change gates, scheduling, or governance decisions.
Schema, focused tests, and reference documentation cover complete, partial, and invalid evidence scenarios.
guidelines: Keep metrics evidence-only; never use it to bypass a required check.
Use exact observed durations and represent unavailable values as unknown.
Document the machine-readable schema and human-readable bottleneck output.

intent.problem: Execution-cost signals are scattered across observability events, so performance bottlenecks and repeated governance work cannot be compared consistently.
constraints: Preserve unknown semantics and fail closed on malformed or cross-item evidence.
Do not alter gate outcomes or scheduling behavior.
intent.rationale: A small, schema-validated report makes the cost of governance visible while keeping measurement separate from policy and execution.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete observability log contains lifecycle and gate timings.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The report preserves observed durations and counts retries, backtracks, and human decisions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused unit test with deterministic event fixtures.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Provider, human, token, or recovery evidence is absent.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Unavailable values remain unknown rather than estimated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused unit test with partial evidence.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A malformed or cross-Work-Item event is present.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Malformed input is rejected and cross-item evidence is excluded fail-closed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused validation tests for malformed JSON and identity mismatch.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized implementation of the complete 14-WI AI Cockpit improvement plan, including governance-cost schema work.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
